cases.name: Diane Suess Kelly
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Diane was born in St. Cloud, MN to Marylene and Lambert Suess and moved to Albany, GA at the age of three. She attended St. Teresa's Catholic School in her youth and graduated from Westover High School in 1973. In 2015, she obtained her diploma in Business Technology from Albany Technical College.

Diane was best described as a sweet soul who loved all people and animals. She never met a person or animal she did not try to help or comfort and extended her care and generosity to all of God's creatures: from stray dogs to neighborhood raccoons. She was an accomplished cook, gardener, seamstress, and had the ability make everything she touched beautiful, in her "dynamite Diane" way. She loved the Lord and sought to honor God with her life. Her greatest joys were her children Kristen and David. She selflessly devoted her life to the betterment of her children, parents, friends and animals, always thinking of others before herself."
cases.narrative: He shot her in the face.
